title: Cathedral of St. Elizabeth
visualBrief: Individual Košice Cathedral of St. Elizabeth:cruciform Gothic stone hall/polygonal choir and lower aisle envelope,patterned tile roofs,slender crossing fleche,unequal western towers with northern clock/onion crown and lower southern dark pyramidal cap,three deep portals/ornamental gables,recessed lights/blind tracery,stepped buttresses and pinnacles. Shared materials/four medium-fi LODs. St. Michael chapel,Urban tower and surrounding streets excluded.
